title: IoT · Luz Tuya low-friction web control
intent: Provide permanent no-download control of the user's Tuya/Smart Life Etheos LAM09SRGB from a mobile web page. Human setup should be reduced to acquiring/pasting one Tuya end-user API key; region, device identity and Thing Model capabilities are discovered automatically.
invariants: Never commit or log Tuya API keys, device IDs, local keys or account data.
Do not overwrite existing CASA or Universal Control surfaces.
No external scripts or third-party analytics on the controller page.
Device control must derive writable properties/ranges from the live Thing Model where possible.
If more than one compatible light exists, require only a one-tap device choice and persist it.
current_frontier: Publish /luz/ on gh-pages, verify served bytes, stop only at the human API-key credential boundary.
human_boundary: Generate a free Tuya Smart Control API key at auth.tuya.ai and paste it once into /luz/.
